description: This file defines the AttachmentsController class, which manages CRUD operations for attachment entities via a REST API, including file upload, retrieval, and deletion.

classes.name: AttachmentsController
classes.description: An API controller for managing file attachments, providing endpoints to upload, download, and delete attachments associated with specified parent entities.

methods.name: GetMany
methods.description: Retrieves a list of attachments for a given parent type and ID, ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific attachment by ID and returns the file stream with appropriate headers for download.

methods.name: DeleteOne
methods.description: Deletes an attachment by ID, removing both the database record and the associated file.

methods.name: CreateMany
methods.description: Handles uploading multiple files linked to a parent entity, saving file data, computing hashes, and storing attachment metadata.
